_comment: compileSdk and targetSdk are a suite-wide API 37 baseline, including
sideload-only apps. API level was not a Play-policy-only migration.
AGP 9.4.0 is the suite toolchain floor for API 37 and provides built-in
Kotlin 2.2.10. Each former AGP 8.5.2 root moved to Gradle 9.7.0;
Kotlin Android plugin usage was removed, and Kotlin sub-plugins track the
built-in compiler. Core Doctor also uses the Compose compiler plugin DSL.
Dependency ceilings remain independent safety rails: API 37 removes the
old platform block, but it does not imply that untested library upgrades
are part of this toolchain migration.
All six Gradle roots now use AGP 9.4.0 / Gradle 9.7.0 / API 37.
AGP 9 provides built-in Kotlin 2.2.10; the external Kotlin Android plugin
is removed. Any remaining Kotlin sub-plugin (Compose, serialization, or
Parcelize) must exactly match that built-in Kotlin version.
Core Doctor applies the compiler plugin at the AGP 9.4.0 built-in Kotlin
version (2.2.10), and the envelope gate checks that wiring.

_comment: The API 37 migration is complete across the suite. This list now records
maintenance boundaries rather than unfinished migration blockers.
steps: All suite Android modules (Icon Pack, Glyphs, Core Line, Core Shift, Core Motion, Core Doctor, Core EQ) compile and target API 37; sideload-only apps are included.
All Gradle roots use AGP 9.4.0 / Gradle 9.7.0. AGP built-in Kotlin is 2.2.10; external kotlin-android is removed, and remaining Kotlin sub-plugins are version-matched.
Core Doctor uses org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose and no longer configures kotlinCompilerExtensionVersion.
CI installs API 37 platform package 37.0 and AGP 9.4.0 build-tools 36.0.0 for suite and release APK builds.
Keep AndroidX, Compose, network, serialization-runtime and coroutine dependency ceilings until each newer dependency line has its own tested migration.
